challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I am willing to give up the full automation of the evaluation harness for now. I accept that we will keep a manual review step for the final model approval. This means I lose the rapid iteration cycle I wanted for testing new weather features. In exchange, I get the assurance that every model change passes the compliance checks before it touches production. I am not asking to remove the manual gate, only to acknowledge that this trade off is necessary to move forward with the heatwave blind spot fixes. The speed of experimentation is the cost I am prepared to pay for regulatory safety.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly accepts giving up the rapid iteration cycle and full automation in exchange for compliance assurance, which defines a trade-off.
